case: Trespassing conviction (Hausfriedensbruch) over 2009 Baden hotel squat
description: Wermuth, then JUSO president and SP vice-president, took part in a January 2009 occupation (squat) of two disused hotels in Baden, Aargau. In 2010 the Baden district office (Bezirksamt) convicted him of trespassing.
outcome: Conditional fine of 20 day-fines plus a CHF 300 penalty; Wermuth chose not to appeal, calling the proceedings politically motivated. About 20 other participants received comparable penalties.
court: Bezirksamt Baden (Baden district office), canton of Aargau
presumption_note: This is a concluded, accepted conviction for a minor offence dating from 2010; no other criminal proceedings against Wermuth are documented in the consulted sources.
key_facts: Action took place in January 2009 at two disused hotels in Baden
Conviction issued by the Baden district office in 2010
Conditional fine of 20 day-fines and a CHF 300 penalty
Wermuth did not appeal and accepted the penalty
